enable_index.description: Enable the use of PostgreSQL to store the Orthanc index

enable_storage.description: Enable the use of PostgreSQL to store the DICOM files

postgresql_host.description: PostgreSQL server hostname or IP address

postgresql_database.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database to use

enable_lock.description: Whether to enable the locking of the PostgreSQL database

enable_ssl.description: Whether to connect to PostgreSQL using SSL

maximum_connection_retries.description: Number of retries when connecting to PostgreSQL or when concurrent transactions cannot be serialized

connection_retry_interval.description: Number of seconds between two attempts when opening a connection to PostgreSQL

index_connections_count.description: Number of connections to PostgreSQL in the connection pool of the index back-end
